name: Anders Monsen & Unna Halsteinsdatter — marriage (1786, Norway)
researcher_question: When and where did Anders Monsen marry Unna Halsteinsdatter, and what does the marriage record show?
notes: The marriage record is real and readable directly by ark (record_read ark:/61903/1:1:NW44-PM2, collection 1468080). It was searchable when the fixture was authored, went missing from the record_search index around 2026-09-16/17 -- confirmed by two independent checks a week apart, and by runs 8, 9 and 10 finding nothing under any query shape -- and RETURNED on 2026-09-30 when Richard Chesworth reloaded collection 1468080. Verified that day: the record ranks 1 of 3, confidence 5, on surname=Monsen givenName=Anders isPrincipal=true spouseGivenName=Urna spouseSurname=Halsteinsdr collectionId=1468080. The spelling is the whole difficulty. The bride is indexed as Urna Halsteinsdr: 'Unna' and the expanded 'Halsteinsdatter' do not return the record, and she is not indexed as a principal at all, so searching her as one returns zero. No run SINCE THE RELOAD has used 'Urna': the 2026-09-30 re-run made twelve searches in the collection without it. Earlier runs did -- run 3 (2026-07-13) tried it extensively with the full surname, and the 2026-09-29 run used it in 13 of its 59 record_search calls, 7 of them in 1468080, including tool_calls[65], which issued exactly the verified query above and returned totalMatches 0 because the record was out of the index that day. Run 1 (2026-07-09), the only success, reached the record by dropping the spouse filter entirely and spotting it among 58 unfiltered candidates. Norwegian patronymic naming (Anders Monsen = son of Mons; Unna Halsteinsdatter = daughter of Halstein) makes both names extremely common, so disambiguation rests on combining both spouses' names with the approximate 1786 date and Hordaland/Meland-area geography.
